name: Rinjoku no Shiro Kairai no Ou
original_name: 凛辱の城 傀儡の王
source:
There is a kingdom where the king takes good care of people. Seemingly, it looks peaceful. However, there is a castle owned by evils floating above them. They are connected with each other through a gate and they can come and go freely. The ones who go through the gate usually carry weapons, so a terrible battle often takes place. The main character is a soldier. He joins a battle against evils and enters the castle. But there is no one inside, just the devil appears. He finally kills the devil and happily comes back to his troop. However, other soldiers see him and say, "Oh, the devil! We'll kill you!!" He doesn't know what is going on, but he defeats them and runs away.... A while later, a girl appears in front of him and says, "You are the devil now. Attack people and rape girls to keep on living." He has been transformed into the devil.... 

[From Himeya Shop]
translation:
有一個王國，國王愛護百姓。表面上看起來太平無事。然而，在他們頭上漂浮著一座惡魔的城堡。兩地有扇門相通，可以自由來往。穿過那扇門的人通常攜帶武器，因此慘烈的戰鬥時有發生。主角是一名士兵。他參加了對抗惡魔的戰鬥，進入了城堡。但裡面空無一人，只有一個惡魔出現。他最終殺死了惡魔，興高采烈地回到部隊。然而，其他士兵看到他說：「啊，惡魔！我們要殺了你！！」他不知道發生了什麼，但還是打敗了他們，逃走了……過了一段時間，一個女孩出現在他面前，說：「你現在已經是惡魔了。攻擊人類、強暴女孩，才能活下去。」他已經被變成惡魔了……

[改編自Himeya Shop]
